description.value: Container Brewing is an award-winning craft brewery and taproom that opened in November 2019 in the heart of Vancouver's Yeast Van Brewing District, built largely by hand by two longtime friends. Their brewer David Dayco has earned recognition at the Canada Beer Cup, BC Beer Awards, and Growlies, with nearly 100 unique beers produced since opening. The space features a patio with a massive outdoor screen for live events, rotating food trucks, and a welcoming, accessibility-conscious atmosphere with a first-floor ramp and accessible washrooms.
